This recipe for '''mutton broth''' has been adapted into modern language from the 1881 Household Cyclopedia.

== Ingredients ==

* 3 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] scrag of fresh [[Cookbook:Mutton|mutton]] neck, cut into several pieces
* 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] cold water
* A few [[Cookbook:Turnip|turnips]], cut into [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]]
* A few branches fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* 1 sprig fresh [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

== Procedure ==

# Wash the mutton pieces, then place in a pot.
# Cover the mutton with the cold water. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then skim well.
# Add the turnips, parsley, thyme, and a little salt.
# Boil gently for 1½ hours. Let cool slightly, and skim the fat from the surface.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] through a fine [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]] to remove the solids.
# Cool thoroughly and as quickly as possible to prevent spoilage.
# Store in the fridge or freezer until use.
